limitations: ON-B-08 must reserve before acceptance, inspect the current matching reservation on retries, and durably fence terminal/unaccepted request keys before recovery. A not-found read or cancellation request is insufficient. Production handshake verification remains an activation gate.
No public API, new UI or runtime registration in this card. Host must derive scope from auth and keep acknowledgement port internal.
Legacy status is imported once. Host must coordinate legacy/new write ownership and reactivation after rollback, never feed synthetic/stale status into initialization.
2,048 durable transition receipts are retained without eviction; exhaustion returns transition_limit for operator investigation.
Unknown future fields survive. Unsupported schema/state and unreadable data fail closed without rewriting records.
Initial build:workflows used the existing builder's standard content-addressed cache; it was then rebuilt into dedicated staging/output paths. No shared cache was removed or daemon restarted.
Pinned Bun 1.4.2 was installed in a separate local toolchain directory; lockfile and dependencies were not changed.
rollback: Disable/unregister journey.v1 or revert this additive code. Keep onboarding-next.journey.v1.* and all legacy settings/profile/connection/job/draft records. No deletion, down migration or automatic reset.

previous_delivery.note: Earlier evidence files remain historical. The recovery-prefixed evidence below binds this revised source tree and supersedes the earlier approval.

review_fixes.change: Internal build_finished_without_draft acknowledges a fenced, confirmed failed/cancelled attempt with no durable draft. Retain request/job/outcome history, permit retry or Explore, reject stale attempts, and preserve saved drafts.

Durable reserve_build must precede job acceptance. Explore and reservations share revision checks; build_started must match the active reserved request. Lost replies and restart retain that request key.
